Select molecules reported in document CHEMBL5291721. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id. Filter by doc_chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5291721'. Return molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name (pref_name), max_phase, molecule_type, and canonical_smiles. Use LEFT JOIN compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles. Do not deduplicate rows. Sort by molecule_chembl_id.
